card.name: Philadelphia publisher in citations
card.fires_on: Mostly the publisher slot in a reference list right after 'Philadelphia, PA', on 'WB' or the colon before 'Saunders' or 'Elsevier Saunders'. Weaker hits fall on small words in pregnancy-risk sentences.

modes.label: Philadelphia publisher citation
modes.description: The 'WB' or colon that comes just before Saunders in a textbook reference ending in 'Philadelphia, PA'.
modes.example: 5th ed. Philadelphia, PA:<< WB>> Saunders Company; 1999

modes.label: Pregnancy wording
modes.description: A small linking word or space in sentences about pregnancy risk or rates.
modes.example: Counsel patients that they are at risk<< of>> pregnancy if they had intercourse in the week

card.plain: It lights up in textbook citations where a Philadelphia publisher like Saunders comes next, and faintly in pregnancy-risk sentences.
